info.title: Creative Loop API
info.description: Floatboat-driven creative-material workflow API with spoken-language detection.

post.description:
Start or reuse the dedicated visible Chrome session.
The user completes login manually through noVNC.

Search Insight using the authenticated browser token.

v0.18.8.1 behavior:
- Results remain ordered by Insight estimated-impression descending.
- material_types is applied BEFORE counting toward top_n.
- If a page contains excluded material types, pagination continues until
  top_n matching results are collected or Insight is exhausted.
- download=true currently supports video-only selections, so image results
  cannot accidentally enter the Whisper/video archive pipeline.

Creative Loop Search Options Live Read

post.description:
Human-readable facade over the already-verified /crawl/search pipeline.

Example:
  traffic_channels = ["Facebook"]
  ad_types          = ["Native Ads"]
  industries        = ["Audiobooks"]

These names are dynamically resolved against Insight's own dictionaries,
then the existing ID-based search route is called directly.

DynamicWatermarkBoxPreviewRequest.title: DynamicWatermarkBoxPreviewRequest
DynamicWatermarkBoxPreviewRequest.description:
Detection-only review request for a reviewed translucent source mark.

This deliberately has no asset, replacement or render fields.  It is a
separate endpoint so a reviewer cannot accidentally turn a trajectory
check into a source-watermark replacement job.

DynamicWatermarkFadePreviewRequest.title: DynamicWatermarkFadePreviewRequest
DynamicWatermarkFadePreviewRequest.description: Detection-backed preview that only fades the source watermark.

DynamicWatermarkTemporalRepairRequest.title: DynamicWatermarkTemporalRepairRequest
DynamicWatermarkTemporalRepairRequest.description: Temporal clean-repair request; never overwrites the source video.

relative_path.title: Relative Path
relative_path.description: Existing media path relative to /workspace, typically review/missing_language/...

use_whisper_english_translation_if_targe.title: Use Whisper English Translation If Target English

relative_path.title: Relative Path
relative_path.description: 工作区内源视频相对路径（如 raw/2026-08-16_0512/ReelShort/Indonesian/x_x.mp4）

competitor_name.title: Competitor Name
competitor_name.description: 已验证的来源产品名称（如 ReelShort），用于 OCR 身份匹配

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: 额外别名（如 Reel Short / Reelshort），合并参与匹配

watermark_asset_relative_path.title: Watermark Asset Relative Path
watermark_asset_relative_path.description: 兼容旧请求的保留字段；动态水印仅局部模糊，不会使用该素材。

own_brand_text.title: Own Brand Text
own_brand_text.description: 兼容旧请求的保留字段；动态水印仅局部模糊，不会渲染该文本。

sample_interval_seconds.title: Sample Interval Seconds
sample_interval_seconds.description: 粗扫采样间隔（秒）；Insightrackr 对有界长视频约 1s 一级

refine_interval_seconds.title: Refine Interval Seconds
refine_interval_seconds.description: 候选时间窗内精扫间隔（秒），用于把短暂出现的移动水印补成 >= 3 点的真实轨迹

refine_window_pad_seconds.title: Refine Window Pad Seconds
refine_window_pad_seconds.description: 候选时间窗两侧外扩用于精扫的秒数

max_total_sample_frames.title: Max Total Sample Frames
max_total_sample_frames.description: 全片 OCR 采样帧总数上限（粗扫 + 精扫合计）

ocr_variants.title: Ocr Variants
ocr_variants.description: OCR 预处理变体；半透明浮水印通常在 CLAHE 增强下更易检出

ocr_min_confidence.title: Ocr Min Confidence
ocr_min_confidence.description: tesseract 置信度下限（0-100 刻度）

min_candidate_confidence.title: Min Candidate Confidence
min_candidate_confidence.description: 进入轨迹构建的候选身份置信度下限（0-1）

output_dir_relative_path.title: Output Dir Relative Path
output_dir_relative_path.description: 输出目录（工作区内相对路径）；缺省为 review/moving_watermark_follow/<时间戳>/<源文件名>/

blur_sigma.title: Blur Sigma
blur_sigma.description: 跟随轨迹的局部高斯模糊强度；只影响已验证水印框及其羽化边缘。

require_receipt_equality.title: Require Receipt Equality
require_receipt_equality.description: 硬门禁：检测到的移动水印动作数必须等于实际渲染动作数，否则任务标记失败

WatermarkAIDecisionRequest.title: WatermarkAIDecisionRequest
WatermarkAIDecisionRequest.description: Schema-validated callback for uncertain local watermark candidates only.
